name: 埃尔娜
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:669
who: Erna, a human grave-digger of the hill town of Greyhedge on the White Stone Plain, fifty-two: about 165 cm, thin but tough, a straight back that has never bent over a grave, a woman who has stood in graveyards all her life. Long deep-purple hair streaked with a few strands of grey, tied back at the nape with a bit of hemp rope. Steady violet eyes that neither dodge nor press. A lean face with high cheekbones, fine clear features and thin lines at the corners of the eyes. Her hands are full of calluses and nail cuts, with dirt that never washes out of the nail beds. A quiet, level, compassionate air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, fine-featured woman's face of about fifty-two, high cheekbones, steady violet almond eyes with fine lines at the outer corners, thin purple-grey eyebrows, a straight small nose, a calm closed mouth; a few soft lines by the mouth, no heavy wrinkles. Skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 165 cm, slim and wiry: thin but strong shoulders and back, a C-cup, a narrow waist and softly rounded hips; she can dig a whole day without bending at the waist.
palette: deep violet and ash grey, grey-brown homespun, iron grey, a little lamp-oil amber
casual: Her grave-digger's clothes: a bleached-out grey-brown coarse cloth dress to the shins with the sleeves rolled, an old wool cloak pulled round the shoulders with mud on the hem, hide shoes wrapped with thongs. On her back a small bundle. She holds a worn-thin iron spade, its shaft wrapped in cloth, point down at her side. A calm, level look.
private: Off duty: the cloak off and folded over one arm, a long-sleeved undyed wool dress with the cuffs turned back, soft hide shoes, the purple-grey hair let down over one shoulder. She holds a mug in both hands. A tired, soft look.
battle: Ready to dig in: the grey-brown dress belted tight with the hemp rope, the old cloak knotted back over the shoulders, leather wraps on the forearms. She grips the iron spade in both hands, the blade up and forward at chest height. A steady, set look.
formal: Dressed for a burial: the cleanest bleached grey-brown wool dress she owns, belted with a braided hemp cord, the old wool cloak brushed and pinned at the throat with a plain bone pin, the hair braided and tied up with the rope, a small lit lamp hanging from one hand whose flame stays steady even in the wind, pale charm-threads for the dead stitched along the cloak hem. She stands straight, a grave quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the violet eyes looking straight at the viewer, steady and kind. Warm lamp light from one side, cold dawn blue from the other. Foreground blur: a flickering grave-lamp flame and drifting earth. She wears the grey cloak with the hemp rope in her hair.

name: 西里尔
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:725
who: Cyril, a human trainee priest of the lamp-tending order on the Altar Isle of Sacred Crossing, nineteen: about 176 cm, slim, narrow-shouldered, a grown young man who has never trained to fight. Short, soft hair the colour of pale mist-blue, a few strands always sticking up at the front. Misty grey-blue eyes that look down first before meeting yours. A narrow, clean face, very pale skin with a faint bluish tint to the veins from a life in the fog, a straight nose, and a clean, honest smile. Lamp oil stains his fingers and will not wash out. A shy, devout, gentle air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young man's narrow, pale, boyish face, NOT angular: soft misty grey-blue almond eyes with a thin tapering dark upper lash line, thin pale blue-grey eyebrows, a small straight nose, a shy mouth with a small clean smile. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool pink tone.
palette: mist blue and pale grey, undyed wool white, lamp-oil amber, damp stone grey
casual: His trainee priest's clothes: a long undyed grey-white wool robe with the hem always damp, a plain rope belt; a lamp hook and a small cloth bag of wicks hanging from the belt on the right; soft-soled shoes. He stands with hands loosely folded, a shy smile.
private: Off duty: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled and plain wool trousers, soft-soled shoes, the hair damp and tousled. He holds a mug of warm milk in both hands, a sleepy gentle look.
battle: Carrying the lamps up at night: the grey-white robe hitched to the knee with the rope belt, a woolen scarf over the shoulders. In his right hand a long lamp hook with a lit lantern swung from its tip, held out in front; the wick bag hangs at his hip. A frightened, determined look; he carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the lamp-carrying outfit: frightened but determined, the shoulders squared, the feet planted, holding a long lamp hook forward with a lit lantern at its tip; he carries no weapon.
formal: For the lighting of the altar lamps: a clean white wool robe worn over a pale grey-blue under-tunic, a woven silver-grey sash, the hair combed flat, the lamp hook held upright in both hands like a staff. A solemn, devout look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the misty grey-blue eyes looking at the viewer a little shyly, a faint clean smile. Warm lamp light from one side, cold fog blue from the other. Foreground blur: a hanging lamp flame and drifting fog. He wears the grey-white wool robe.

name: 葛丽塔
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:781
who: Greta, a human stonemason of the Black Stone Highlands, twenty-three: about 176 cm, tall, broad in the shoulders and thick through the back, strong arms with every sinew showing. Very short deep copper-red hair, cut shorter than most men's, with stone dust always caught in the ends. Emerald-green eyes under thick eyebrows that rise first when she is angry. A square face with a shallow scar on the chin from a chip of flying stone, and lips pressed hard when she is straining. A stubborn, blunt, warm-hearted air. Despite the cropped hair and strong shoulders she is unmistakably a young woman of twenty-three, NOT a boy or a young man: a woman's softer jawline and cheeks, fuller lips, longer lashes, and a clearly female figure under the smock and shirt in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a square-jawed young woman's face of about twenty-three, thick copper-red eyebrows, sharp emerald-green almond eyes, a straight nose, a pressed, determined mouth; a shallow scar on the middle of the chin. Skin shadows a soft warm tone. This is clearly a young woman's face, not a boy's: softer cheeks and jaw, fuller lips, long lashes.
build: 176 cm, tall and broad-shouldered: wide strong shoulders and a thick back, a C-cup, a narrow waist and solid, full hips; she can swing a hammer all day.
palette: copper red and stone grey, canvas beige, emerald green, rust brown
casual: Her stonemason's work clothes: a thick canvas work smock with leather patches sewn on the knees and elbows, a wide leather belt hung with a set of chisels, thick boots. Over one shoulder she carries a big hammer whose head is carved from yellow-rock beast bone, with an old hand towel wound round the haft. A stubborn, bright grin.
private: Off duty: the work smock off, a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled over the elbows, plain wool trousers, soft socks and slippers, the old hand towel round her neck, a mug in one hand. A tired, easy grin.
battle: Ready to smash a gate: the canvas smock belted tight, leather bracers on both forearms, the chisel belt cinched. She grips the big yellow-rock beast-bone hammer in both hands, the head up behind her shoulder, the haft wound with the old towel. A fierce, set look.
formal: Dressed for a feast: her one good set, a clean linen shirt with a laced neck, a dark green wool jerkin laced up the front, a wide leather belt with a small cast-bronze mason's badge, clean boots, a neat ribbon wound round her wrist, and a chip of yellow-rock beast bone on a cord at her throat that glows faintly amber. She stands straight, a shy, proud grin.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the emerald eyes looking at the viewer with a stubborn, bright look, one eyebrow raised. Warm forge-orange light from one side, cold stone-grey from the other. Foreground blur: flying stone chips and drifting dust. She wears the canvas work smock.

name: 无赦者·科尔宾
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:1716
who: Corbin, a human former miner who walked thirteen death trials, a legend who now looks to be nearly sixty: about 198 cm, a head taller than anyone, enormously wide and thick through the chest and shoulders. Short-shaved glossy black hair, grey at the temples. Dim gold eyes like the light of a miner's lamp, who look first at your hands, then your shoulders, then at last your face. A strong, upright face with a high brow ridge, a faint old scar across the bridge of the nose, and a small notch missing from the top of his left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Around his neck a leather cord threaded with thirteen small copper tags, twelve engraved and the last left blank. A calm, silent, unyielding air. The small notch missing from the top of his left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is clearly drawn as a bite-shaped gap in the ear's upper rim, visible in every panel where that ear shows.
face: FACE, as in the references: a heavy, upright man's face of nearly sixty, a high brow ridge, dim gold eyes with deep lines at the corners, short black eyebrows touched with grey, a straight nose with a faint old scar across the bridge, a firm closed mouth; a small notch missing from the top of the left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Skin shadows a soft warm tone. The eyes are a dim amber-gold like a miner's lamp, clearly GOLD and NOT grey or blue, the same eye colour as his younger self.
build: 198 cm, enormous and wide: thick shoulders, a deep chest and a heavy back, thick arms covered with old calluses, solid legs.
palette: dim lamp gold and ore grey, old leather brown, dark iron, a little copper
casual: The same worn clothes he has had for decades: a patched coarse hemp shirt with the sleeves rolled, over it the old leather coat the city gave him after his sentence, a short hip-length hide coat with no lapels, laced at the chest with thongs and patched again and again; plain trousers, heavy worn boots. A leather cord at his neck holds thirteen copper tags, the last one blank. He is bare-handed and carries no weapon. A calm, level look.
private: Off duty: the old leather coat off and folded over one forearm, the hemp shirt open at the collar with the sleeves pushed up, bare forearms. The copper tags lie on his chest. He stands easy, a silent, patient look.
battle: Ready to grapple: the short old hide coat belted tight, the sleeves pushed up, thick leather wraps round both fists and forearms. He carries no weapon: the twelve engraved copper tags glow a dull ember red at his chest, and he stands wide-legged with both bare hands open and low, ready to seize. A heavy, set look.
battle_pose: 3) the bare-handed outfit: wide-legged and low, both open hands held ready in front of the body to seize an opponent, the shoulders hunched forward; he carries no weapon.
formal: His most formal look: the short old hide coat brushed and laced over a clean hemp shirt, the hair freshly cropped, the thirteen copper tags laid out on the outside of the coat, twelve of them faintly warm with a dull red glow. He stands straight and still with his hands at his sides, a heavy, silent look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and still, the dim gold eyes looking at the viewer with a steady, weighing look, ageing but unbowed. Warm lamp-gold light from one side, cold ore grey from the other. Foreground blur: the thirteen copper tags dangling near the lens. He wears the old leather coat.

name: 科尔宾
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:848
who: Corbin, a human miner of the northern pit in the Black Stone Highlands, thirty-four, sentenced to walk thirteen death trials: about 198 cm, a head taller than a city guard, enormously wide and thick, with shoulders and back full of hard muscle. Short-shaved glossy black hair, a layer of dark stubble on the chin. Dim gold eyes like the light of a miner's lamp, who look first at your hands, then your shoulders, then at last your face. A strong, handsome face with a high brow ridge, an old scar across the bridge of the nose, and a small notch missing from the top of his left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Arms as thick as pit props. A silent, patient, unyielding air. The small notch missing from the top of his left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is clearly drawn as a bite-shaped gap in the ear's upper rim, visible in every panel where that ear shows.
face: FACE, as in the references: a heavy, upright man's face of thirty-four, a high brow ridge, dim gold eyes, thick black eyebrows, a straight nose with an old scar across the bridge, a firm closed mouth, dark stubble on the chin; a small notch missing from the top of the left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 198 cm, wide and thick: a deep chest, heavy shoulders and back, arms like pit props, hands layered with calluses.
palette: dim lamp gold and ore grey, hemp beige-brown, old leather brown, dark iron
casual: His miner's clothes: a coarse hemp shirt and trousers with torn-out knees, and over it the old leather coat the city gave him after the sentence, a short hip-length hide coat with no lapels, laced at the chest with thongs. Around his neck a leather cord threaded with thirteen copper tags, all still blank. He is bare-handed and carries no weapon. A calm, level look.
private: Off duty: the leather coat off and folded over one forearm, the hemp shirt open at the collar with the sleeves pushed up, bare feet. The blank copper tags lie on his chest. He stands easy, a silent patient look.
battle: Ready to grapple a wolf: the short old hide coat belted tight, the sleeves pushed up, thick leather wraps round both fists and forearms, the blank copper tags at his chest. He carries no weapon and stands wide-legged with both bare hands open and low. A heavy, set look.
battle_pose: 3) the bare-handed outfit: wide-legged and low, both open hands held ready in front of the body to seize an opponent, the shoulders hunched forward; he carries no weapon.
formal: Dressed to hear a sentence: the short old hide coat brushed and laced over a clean hemp shirt, the stubble shaved, the thirteen blank tags laid on the outside of the coat, plain trousers, worn boots. He stands straight with his hands at his sides, a heavy, silent look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and still, the dim gold eyes looking at the viewer with a steady, weighing look. Warm lamp-gold light from one side, cold ore grey from the other. Foreground blur: the thirteen blank copper tags dangling near the lens. He wears the old leather coat.

name: 鲁娜
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:904
who: Runa, a human coppersmith's daughter of Cleftstone town in the Black Stone Highlands, nineteen: small, about 157 cm, slight and quick, a grown young woman. Cherry-pink long hair plaited into one thick braid and coiled under a leather cap, the ends always glittering with copper filings. Amber eyes that narrow when she looks at things, as if measuring. A round face with a pointed chin and a smear of black soot on one cheek. Slender fingers with calluses at the tips from the chisel. A busy, sharp, warm air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a round, small-chinned young woman's face of about nineteen, amber almond eyes narrowed in concentration, thin cherry-pink eyebrows, a small nose, a determined mouth; a smear of black soot on the cheek on the viewer's left. Skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 157 cm, small and light: a slim build, a B-cup, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: cherry pink and amber, copper orange, soot black, leather brown
casual: Her coppersmith's work clothes: a leather apron burned through with several small holes over a plain wool dress, a leather cap over the coiled braid. A leather holster at her belt holds seven chisels of different sizes. Round her neck on a cord hangs a small copper tag engraved with a bird. A bright, intent look.
private: Off duty: the apron and cap off, a long-sleeved undyed wool dress with the cuffs turned back, the braid hanging over one shoulder, soft shoes. She holds a small copper tag and a little file, a sleepy, pleased look.
battle: Ready to defend her shop: the burned apron tied tight, leather gloves on, the cap pulled low. She holds the longest chisel in her right hand like a short blade, held forward at waist height, the other six still in the belt holster; the tag hangs at her neck. A fierce, wary look.
battle_pose: 3) the craftswoman's defensive outfit: wary and fierce, the feet planted apart, holding the longest chisel forward in one hand like a short blade; she is a small craftswoman, not a trained fighter.
formal: For a feast day: a clean dyed blue wool dress with a laced bodice, a white linen collar, the braid unpinned and wound with a copper ribbon, the little bird tag shining on its cord. She stands straight with her chin up, a shy proud smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the amber eyes narrowed as if measuring the viewer, a small crooked smile. Orange forge-fire light from one side, cold grey daylight from the other. Foreground blur: flying copper filings and a half-engraved tag held up near the lens. She wears the burned leather apron.

name: 博德
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:969
who: Bode, a human butcher from the old holy ground in the east, forty-six: about 182 cm, thick-set and heavy, broad through the chest and belly, forearms as thick as the pig legs he has jointed. A clean-shaved head polished bright, a ring of short beard round the chin. Wine-red eyes with dark circles under them from eleven years of no proper sleep, and still bright. A wide face that creases into two deep lines at both cheeks when he smiles. His fingers are crossed with old knife scars. A steady, patient, big-hearted air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a wide, heavy man's face of about forty-six, a shaved head, wine-red almond eyes with dark circles beneath, thick dark-brown eyebrows, a short ring of beard round the chin, a broad nose, deep smile lines at both cheeks, tired but warm. Skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 182 cm, thick and heavy: a broad chest and a round belly, thick forearms, strong legs.
palette: wine red and tallow white, old leather brown, candle yellow, scrubbed pink
casual: His butcher's clothes: an oily old leather apron worn for eleven years and patched again and again, over a plain coarse wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up high, dark trousers and heavy boots. A short boning knife is tucked into his belt, its blade marked with rows of tiny notches. A warm, tired smile.
private: Off duty: the apron off, the wool shirt open at the collar with rolled sleeves, soft old shoes. He holds a small clay jar in one hand and a tallow candle in the other, a quiet, sleepy smile.
battle: Ready to hold his ground: the leather apron tied tight, thick leather wraps on both forearms. He grips the short boning knife in his right hand, held low and forward, the other hand open to guard. A heavy, steady look.
formal: For the end of a long vigil: a clean undyed wool shirt with a laced neck, the old apron brushed and tied on, a grey-brown wool cloak pinned at the shoulder with a small bronze sun-temple badge, a small white candle in his cupped hands whose flame does not gutter. He stands straight, a calm, warm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the wine-red eyes looking at the viewer, tired and bright, a slow warm smile. Warm candle light from one side, cold blue night from the other. Foreground blur: a tallow candle flame and wisps of wax smoke. He wears the old leather apron.

name: 罗薇娜
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:1025
who: Rowena, a human trainee priestess of the sun-temple of Tonathu in Goldcrown City, twenty-two: about 163 cm, slender with a straight back. A long wheat-gold braid hanging down her back, a few short strands at the front lightened by the sun. Pale gold eyes like early light on a temple door. A layer of freckles across the nose, a small face with a pointed chin, and lips that press together until she suddenly smiles. Thin cuts from hourglass glass on her fingers. A quiet, earnest, hopeful air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a small, delicate young woman's face of about twenty-two, pale gold almond eyes, thin wheat-gold eyebrows, a light spray of freckles over the nose, a small straight nose, a pressed mouth that suddenly smiles, a pointed small chin. Skin shadows a soft warm pink tone.
build: 163 cm, slender: a narrow frame and a straight back, a B-cup, a slim waist and softly rounded hips.
palette: wheat gold and pale gold, sun-temple white, ochre thread, a little sand
casual: Her temple clothes: a long white linen robe with a sun embroidered on the chest in ochre thread, the hem covered in grass seeds from the road. A leather case on her back holds an hourglass whose glass has a crack sealed with wax. At her belt hangs a small wooden tally board with a stick of charcoal. A bright, earnest look.
private: Off duty: the robe off, a loose undyed linen dress with the sleeves rolled and a woollen shawl, soft shoes, the braid over one shoulder. She holds the cracked hourglass in both hands, a quiet drowsy look.
battle: Ready to hold her ground: the white robe hitched at the waist with a belt, a short travelling cloak on, the sleeves tied back. Both hands raise the cracked wax-sealed hourglass high in front of her like a shield; the tally board stays at her belt. A frightened, firm look; she carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the hourglass outfit: frightened but firm, the feet planted, both hands raising a cracked wax-sealed hourglass high in front of her like a shield; she carries no weapon.
formal: For calling the dawn hour: a clean white linen robe with the ochre sun embroidered large on the chest, a wheat-gold sash, the braid pinned up with a plain bone pin, the hourglass held upright in front of her. She stands straight, a solemn, hopeful look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the pale gold eyes looking at the viewer, earnest and hopeful, a small smile just beginning. Warm early-sun gold from one side, cold pale blue from the other. Foreground blur: a falling thread of hourglass sand and drifting grass seeds. She wears the white robe with the ochre sun.

name: 布丽吉德
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:1090
who: Brigid, a human woodcutter's daughter from the forest edge, sixteen: small, about 158 cm, a lean, sturdy build, fully covered by her clothes. Messy short red hair she cut herself with a billhook, sticking out above her ears. Deep pine-green eyes with a quick glance that never rests long on a face. A scatter of freckles across her face, a nose tip reddened by the mountain wind. Her hands are covered with calluses and blisters from an axe handle. A fast, stubborn, fiery young air, like a small pine that refuses to fall in the wind.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young girl's lively face, deep pine-green almond eyes with a quick sideways glance, thin copper-red eyebrows, a light scatter of freckles across the nose and cheeks, a small nose with a wind-reddened tip, a firm small mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm pink tone.
palette: rust red and pine green, undyed homespun, birch bark brown, resin amber
casual: Her woodcutter family's clothes: a rough homespun short tunic with the sleeves rolled to the elbows over plain wool leggings, cloth leg wraps and sturdy hide boots. Her father's old felling axe, its haft longer than her forearm, is held in one hand with the head down at her side. On her back a wooden carrying frame. A bright, wary look, the mouth closed.
private: Off duty: a long-sleeved undyed wool dress to the shins with the cuffs turned back, thick knitted stockings, hide house shoes, the messy red hair tousled. She holds a wooden bowl in both hands. A content look, the mouth closed.
battle: Carrying fire: the homespun tunic belted with a hemp rope, the sleeves rolled, leg wraps tight, a short cloak. On her back the wooden frame loaded with a bundle of resin torches; in her right hand a lit pine torch held forward, the axe hung in a loop at the belt. A fierce, set look, the eyes open and the mouth shut.
formal: For a festival: her one good set, a clean dyed green wool dress to the shins with a laced front, a white linen collar, the short red hair brushed, a sprig of pine in her hand. She stands up straight, a bright serious look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the deep pine-green eyes looking straight at the viewer, bright and serious, the mouth closed. Warm resin-torch orange from one side, cold forest blue from the other. Foreground blur: drifting pine needles and sparks. She wears the homespun tunic.

name: 洛瑟恩
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:1146
who: Lothern, an elf of the Warden clan of the Primeval Forest, about two hundred and sixty years old, who looks like a man of about twenty-five: tall, about 188 cm, lean and long-limbed, straight in the shoulders and back. Long silver-grey hair tied back at the nape with a leather cord, long pointed ears showing through the hair. Pale spring-green eyes that look at a person for a long time. A narrow face with long eyes and fine features, skin as pale as white stone. Slender hands with a deep old groove on the right index finger from two hundred years of drawing a string. A slow, still, watchful air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a narrow, fine-featured young elf man's face, long pale spring-green almond eyes, thin silver-grey eyebrows, a straight small nose, a calm closed mouth, long pointed ears. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 188 cm, tall and lean: a long-limbed slim frame, straight shoulders and back.
palette: silver grey and spring green, forest cloak grey-green, white stone, a little pale leather
casual: His Warden's clothes: a grey-green hooded cloak with the hood always down on his back, over a plain undyed tunic and soft leggings, with soft leather boots. On his back he carries a long Warden's bow; at his belt is a quiver whose arrows are all there, not one missing. A calm, far-seeing look.
private: Off duty: the cloak off and folded over one arm, a loose pale green linen shirt with the cuffs open, soft leggings, the hair loosened. He holds the unstrung bow loosely in one hand, a quiet, distant look.
battle: Ready on the line: the grey-green cloak pinned back at the shoulders, leather bracers on both forearms, the quiver full at his belt. He holds the long bow drawn half-way, the string back halfway to his cheek with no arrow loosed, the bow limb scorched black from fire. A still, watchful look.
battle_pose: 3) the warden outfit: still and watchful, the feet set apart, the long bow drawn half-way with no arrow loosed, the bow limb scorched black; he does not shoot.
formal: For the Warden's council: a long pale grey-green robe with a silver-embroidered leaf collar over his leggings, a woven silver belt, the hair brushed and tied, the bow left on his back. He stands upright, a quiet, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the pale spring-green eyes looking at the viewer for a long time, a calm and faintly sad look. Cold clear dawn light from one side, warm distant fire-glow from the other. Foreground blur: drifting ash and a single drifting leaf. He wears the grey-green hooded cloak.

name: 奥瑞克
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:1202
who: Orik, a human lamplighter of Pinegate town at the forest edge, twenty: tall and thin, about 180 cm, long-legged and wiry. Messy sandy-yellow hair, with one lock curled by lamp-fire singeing at the front. Orange-red eyes that shine strangely bright when he looks at a lamp at night. A freckled face with a pointed chin, and when he laughs a chipped front tooth shows, half of one tooth missing. The tips of all ten fingers are black from lamp soot. A quick, cheeky, warm air. The tips of all ten fingers are visibly blackened with lamp soot in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, freckled young man's face of about twenty, quick orange-red almond eyes, thin sandy-yellow eyebrows with one lock of singed hair curling in at the front, a small nose with freckles, a wide mouth with a half-chipped front tooth, a pointed chin. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone. When he grins, one of his two upper front teeth is clearly chipped, half of that tooth missing, leaving a visible notch in the row of teeth.
build: 180 cm, thin and long-legged: a wiry frame, quick limbs.
palette: sandy yellow and flame orange, soot black, oilcloth brown, a little brass
casual: His lamplighter's clothes: plain black cloth clothes, a waxed oilcloth cape over the shoulders, soft boots. In his right hand he holds a long lamp pole with a brass hook and a small fire pot at its head, point up. At his belt an oil flask, a roll of wick and a short chopping knife. A cheeky, bright grin.
private: Off duty: the cape off, a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up and plain trousers, worn slippers. He holds the unlit lamp pole in one hand and a rag in the other, a sleepy cheeky grin.
battle: Ready to carry fire through the dark: the black clothes belted tight, the oilcloth cape tied back, a leather glove on the left hand. He holds the lamp pole forward in both hands, the small fire pot at its head flaring, the short chopping knife still in his belt. A tense, bright-eyed look.
formal: For a lamp festival: a clean black wool tunic belted with a braided leather strap, a white linen shirt showing at the laced neck, a short black cape trimmed with a band of oilcloth, the sooty fingers scrubbed, the hair combed down, a freshly lit small lamp held in both hands, its flame leaning toward the viewer as if alive. He stands up straight, a shy proud grin.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the orange-red eyes looking at the viewer, bright and cheeky, a crooked grin showing the chipped tooth. Warm lamp-fire orange from one side, cold night blue from the other. Foreground blur: a lamp flame and floating sparks. He wears the black cloth clothes and the oilcloth cape.

name: 裂石城的老伯爵
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:1588
who: The old count of Cleftstone, the northernmost of the twelve noble houses of the Black Stone Highlands, in his sixties: tall and thin, about 178 cm, a ramrod-straight back. White hair cut short and a clean-shaven, lean face. Steel-blue eyes, cold and level. The little finger of his left hand is bent crooked (on the viewer's right when he faces us). On his head sits an iron crown set with the iron-grey glowing core of an iron-hide wolf he slew as a young man. A bronze house badge is worn on his chest. A silent, severe, unchanging air. The little finger of his left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is clearly drawn bent crooked sideways at the middle joint, visibly different from the other four fingers, and kept visible whenever that hand is shown.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, stern old man's face in his sixties, steel-blue almond eyes with deep lines at the corners, thin white eyebrows, a straight sharp nose, a firm thin closed mouth, deep lines from nose to mouth. Skin shadows a soft cool tone.
palette: iron grey and steel blue, bronze, black wool, a little white
casual: His count's everyday clothes: a heavy dark charcoal wool tunic to the knee over black trousers and boots, a bronze house badge cast with a beast head pinned on the chest, a long dark cloak, the iron crown with its iron-grey core on his head. His left hand rests at his belt with the little finger bent. A severe, level look.
private: Off duty: the crown and badge off, a plain long grey wool house-robe over a white shirt, soft indoor shoes, a rolled strip of parchment held in one hand. A heavy silent look.
battle: Armoured: a bronze-hide cuirass over the dark wool tunic, bronze-plated pauldrons, the long cloak thrown back, the iron crown with its core still on his head. His right hand rests on the hilt of a plain heavy broadsword at his hip; his left hangs open. A cold, set look.
formal: For reading a sentence: a long black wool robe belted with a bronze-studded strap, a heavy bronze house badge cast with a beast head on the chest, a dark cloak pinned with a bronze brooch, the iron crown with its iron-grey beast core on his head, the core faintly pulsing, a rolled parchment held in both hands. He stands upright and unmoving, a cold, severe look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and still, the steel-blue eyes looking at the viewer coldly and without hurry. Cold grey stone-hall light from one side, faint warm torch glow from the other. Foreground blur: the iron-grey glowing core of the crown near the lens. He wears the dark wool tunic with the bronze badge.

name: 裂石城伯爵的小儿子
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_一_晨祷.md:1588
who: The youngest son of the old count of Cleftstone, a boy of twelve: about 142 cm, thin as a pit prop, fully covered by his clothes. Copper-brown straight hair cut to the chin. Very large steel-blue eyes. A narrow serious face with a pointed chin, and ink on his fingers. A quiet, watchful, curious air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a child's narrow serious face, very large steel-blue almond eyes, thin copper-brown eyebrows, a small nose, a small closed mouth, a pointed small chin. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
palette: copper brown and steel blue, bronze, charcoal wool, grey stone
casual: His nobleman's son clothes: a charcoal wool tunic to the knee with a small bronze house badge pinned on the chest, grey wool trousers, a short dark cloak, sturdy boots. He stands with both hands folded in front, a watchful, serious look, the mouth closed.
private: Off duty: a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt with the cuffs turned back, plain trousers, soft house shoes, the hair tousled. He holds a wax tablet and a stylus, a quiet curious look.
battle: Standing watch: the charcoal tunic belted, the short cloak pinned back, leather gloves on. He holds a small wooden practice staff upright beside him with both hands, the feet planted, a brave, set look.
battle_pose: 3) the watch outfit: brave and set, the feet planted, holding a small wooden practice staff upright beside him with both hands; he is only a child.
formal: For his father's hall: a clean black wool tunic belted with a leather strap, a small bronze house badge cast with a beast head on the chest, with a tiny iron-grey crumb of beast core set in it, a short dark cloak pinned with a bronze brooch, the hair neatly combed, a rolled parchment held in both hands. He stands straight, a serious, shy look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the huge steel-blue eyes looking at the viewer with quiet curiosity, the mouth closed. Cold grey daylight from one side, a hint of warm torch glow from the other. Foreground blur: a stone parapet edge and drifting dust. He wears the charcoal tunic with the small bronze badge.
